acceptance_conditions: NFT-ready media and metadata generation completes before any mint request
minting is optional and requires a separate confirmation showing wallet, network, and estimated fee
the sharing user receives the NFT and pays the minting fee only when minting is confirmed
declining or not confirming minting creates no mint fee and no blockchain effect
the first network is Solana devnet; mainnet is out of scope
the NFT is bound to one exact Knowledge Artifact Version
NFT possession or transfer grants no definition ownership, KEP co-ownership, copyright, license, publication right, or protocol authority
exclusions: automatic minting when the user requests only representation generation
charging a mint fee or submitting any blockchain transaction without a separate valid mint confirmation
minting to the KEP recipient; the selected recipient is the sharing user's confirmed wallet
treating a Solana wallet, public key, NFT owner, or fee payer as a KEP Knowledge Identity

treating NFT creation, possession, or transfer as Knowledge Co-Ownership, a Co-Ownership Grant, definition ownership, copyright, license, publication permission, governance authority, or proof that the represented definition is true or admitted
changing the exact definition version, propagation policy, KEP owner set, recipient access, or encryption material through NFT generation or minting
mainnet, production funds, production credentials, customer artifacts, publication, release, deployment, resale, royalties, marketplace behavior, or token-gated access
selecting an image generator, metadata standard, storage provider, wallet adapter, Solana token program, retry algorithm, or implementation architecture
claiming Product Capability adoption, business-ontology admission, DomainSpec construction, implementation, conformance, security review, operational readiness, or customer value
prepared_fields.outcome: For one exact definition-bearing Knowledge Artifact Version shared through KEP, let the sharing user optionally request one NFT-ready media-and-metadata representation bound to that exact version; after generation, let that same user either stop with no fee or blockchain effect, or separately confirm the receiving wallet, Solana devnet, exact commitments, and estimated fee before one mint attempt produces a correlated terminal receipt.
